body: Original logo-free 2994 game vehicle sprite sheet, transparent background, landscape 7:4, eight whole separated views in regular 4-column by 2-row grid. Same 2015 US Volkswagen Golf GTI Mk7 TWO-DOOR hatchback inspired body: one long door each side, short rear quarter windows, practical squared hatch, angular narrow headlights, honeycomb lower grille without badges, modest roof spoiler, dual round rear exhausts. No Golf R, no five-door rear handles, no logos, emblems, GTI letters or text. Deep petrol teal body, one weathered bronze replacement front fender, restrained salvage repairs, dark window surrounds. ALL road wheels removed, clean transparent wheel-arch holes for runtime tires, no shadows/ground. Strict view order top FRONT, FRONT-LEFT quarter noseRIGHT, LEFT SIDE noseRIGHT, REAR-LEFT quarter noseRIGHT; bottom REAR, REAR-RIGHT quarter noseLEFT, RIGHT SIDE noseLEFT, FRONT-RIGHT quarter noseLEFT. Generous transparent margins around every car, no clipping. Consistent detailed painterly realism, shallow orthographic elevation.
dashboard: Original logo-free 2994 vehicle-specific cockpit overlay, ultrawide 3:1 transparent PNG, LEFT-hand-drive 2015 US Volkswagen Golf GTI Mk7 S inspired dashboard. Broad angular charcoal dashboard, hooded driver instrument binnacle LEFT at quarter width with empty black rectangular gauge face, angled center stack with blank rectangular 5.8-inch infotainment display between slim rectangular vents and three manual climate knobs below, silver horizontal trim with restrained red stitch accents. No modern tablet, no giant digital dash. Worn black surfaces and subtle teal repaired trim. No steering wheel or hands; runtime shared wheel and live gauges added later. Blank instruments, no digits, letters, logos or manufacturer badges. Windshield opening fully transparent; A-pillars thin at sides, dash opaque to bottom. Realistic painterly original game art, faithful compact hatch cockpit proportions.
orientationCorrection: Correct this eight-view car sprite sheet, preserving its teal two-door hot hatch design, orange-bronze repaired front fender, absent wheels, transparent background and all eight separate cells. Critical: it currently repeats orientations. Make top row cells exactly: straight FRONT; FRONT LEFT three-quarter with nose pointing RIGHT; full LEFT profile with nose pointing RIGHT; REAR LEFT three-quarter with nose pointing RIGHT. Bottom row: straight REAR; REAR RIGHT three-quarter with nose pointing LEFT; full RIGHT profile with nose pointing LEFT; FRONT RIGHT three-quarter with nose pointing LEFT. All 8 views must show the same two-door hatch, one long door per side, no badges, logos, text, wheels, tires or shadows. Correct bottom row cells 2 and 3 by turning the vehicle to point LEFT, and top row cell 2 to point RIGHT. Keep generous transparent margins and gutters in an exact 4x2 grid. Entire car must fit each cell including bumpers. Distinct left and right body views. Original game art in year2994 distressed photorealistic painterly style.
